board: Adafruit 1.2" 4-Digit 7-Segment Display w/I2C Backpack (#1270 red / #1269 yellow), original 5-pin backpack (C, D, -, +, IO)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator shows 1234 and prints 'showing 12:34', PCB DRC clean). Pin order taken from Adafruit's 1.2in 7-segment backpack PCB file (JP1 pads 1-5 = SCL/C, SDA/D, GND/-, VDD/+, IO); digit RAM map 0,2,6,8 and indicator bits from Adafruit's library; IO (pull-up supply) marked not required so it is never auto-wired to 5 V, and the docs say to wire it to 3.3 V. The 2023 STEMMA QT revision may have a different header.
